other: Default, with no special effects.
Start with a DISCHARGE SUMMARY, which should be discarded for +20 EXPERIENCE.
Start with a MEDICAL KIT, which can either heal 1 Major Injury, or be USED to open it and gain 2 BANDAGES.
Any combat damage you receive has a chance to also cause a random INJURY.
Completing mysteries reduces DOOM by an additional -1%.
You may encounter the unique enemies CULTIST HUNTER A and CULTIST HUNTER B.
Start with +4 FUNDS.
Cannot have HUMAN allies. Any recruited ally will be immediately removed along with a notification describing their death.
The HERMIT (if unlocked) is immune to this effect.
The possible [dog] allies from the TRAPPED DOG event are also immune.
Start with 133 EXPERIENCE (except Juri, who only starts with 66 EXP).
All event skill check rolls are automatically set to 99, making them guaranteed failures.
Certain required mystery story events and lighthouse skill checks are the exception, and function normally.
Start with an INSPIRING NOVEL, which can be used once to grant +2 damage dealt until the mystery ends.
Completing a mystery with any ending other than ENDING A, will result in gaining +6% DOOM.
Timeline B settings make ENDING A of certain mysteries impossible to achieve.
Start with -3 MAX STAMINA and -3 MAX REASON.
Enemies deal -1 damage in combat.
Start with an OLD COIN, which can be used once to remove a CURSE, including some unique personal status effects.
Any combat damage you receive has a chance to also inflict you with a random CURSE.
Start with +20 MAX STAMINA and +20 MAX REASON.
You cannot recover or increase STAMINA or REASON in any way or amount. The value can only go down.
Each location is limited to 1 additional action, such as shops.
Some of these services are irreplacable, so choose carefully.
Mysteries names are hidden while on the board before they are investigated.
You must complete mysteries in the order they are arranged on the board.
You cannot gain EXPERIENCE in any way or amount.
